text:
maya: idea: "partitioned-slit" rollout - partition tenants into fixed slices, ramp per-slice, and use two-tier fallback: router emergency short-circuit + controller persistent rollback.

ajay: nice. KV cache warmup is main risk. flipping mid-session blows tail p95.

sam: session-affinity header with TTL (10m) prevents mid-session moves during ramp.

liz: add smoothing: evaluate p95 and err over 5m windows, debounce 2m to avoid chatter.

nora: router vs controller? router = fast local guard, controller = global reconciler. hybrid seems sane.

ajay: router guards must be stateless; use header tokens and tiny LRU for recent flips. controller writes slice targets to config store. routers poll.

maya: config sketch: slices=128, rollout_steps=[1,3,10,25], step_sec=900, session_affinity_ttl=600, fallback:{p95_ms:300, err_pct:1.5, eval_sec:300, debounce_sec:120}, router_local_guard:{p95_ms:450, err_pct:5.0}.

liz: reserve 3% golden traffic excluded from slices for baseline. also limit alerts when guard fires repeatedly.

sam: warmup probe per-slice: synthetic KV + short seq; only ramp after probe_success metric.

nora: telemetry: emit per-slice aggregates (p95, err, cache_miss), sample tenant traces only on anomaly to control cardinality.

ajay: soft-backoff option: if cache_miss_rate high, slow down ramp before hard rollback.

maya: ops commands: /pilot pause|rollback|promote <id> with audit log. runbook: pager if router guard trips 3 windows in a row.

deploy-bot: deploy maya/partitioned-slit -> model-v6 started slices=128 initial=1% :rocket:

maya: action items: RFC + router PR + controller PR + observability + runbook. owner: maya. deadline: next Tue.

liz: +1, cc platform + observability.
